name: Modus
long_description:
Modus helps companies hire and retain only the people they need instead of becoming bloated messes. Modus connects your HRIS, ATS, and analyzes extensive data across your organization so leaders can detect, inspect, and correct their workforce plans - without relying on spreadsheets or complex systems. 
 
Lin experienced these challenges firsthand as a VP BizOps at HashiCorp, scaling from 100 employees to IPO, while Chris and Amar faced similar issues scaling 40+ person teams as a fractional CTO. They’re motivated by the belief that companies should have the least number of employees possible.
one_liner: Unlock revenue per employee with AI-powered headcount management

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our ‘level 5’ vision is to automate workforce management at scale and to build efficient companies with the least number of employees possible.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Lin is Co-founder and CEO of Modus. Before Modus, she was a VP BizOps at HashiCorp and helped scale from 100 to 2500 employees to IPO (rang the bell in NY). 

Prior to that, she implemented ERP systems at five Fortune 500 companies as a Deloitte Consultant. The clunky nature of these tools led her to appreciate the flexibility of spreadsheets but also the craft in modern software. 

Lin received her Bachelor's in Econ, Comp Sci, and Math at NYU Stern.

launches.title: Modus: Headcount management to save costs as you scale
launches.tagline: We help companies hire and retain only the people they need without the unnecessary bloat.
launches.body:
[Modus](https://www.himodus.com) is headcount management that helps companies never over-hire as they scale. Modus brings Finance, HR, and Hiring Managers to detect, inspect, and correct their workforce plan in one unified workflow.

Today, much time is wasted reconciling headcount across departments and exporting across disparate systems. Incomplete and outdated data adds to the pain. Companies overhire, then fire. Cycle perpetuates. Bloat and inefficiencies persist.

[Lin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/linling1/) experienced these pains directly as VP of BizOps at HashiCorp, scaling from 100 to 2500 through IPO. Modus was founded on the belief that companies should have the fewest employees possible.

# 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83088&key=user_uploads/1899616/a1595755-bf0e-4166-a296-2badb2dcff54)

# 🤯 **The Problem: Headcount planning and reporting remains manual and painful**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83088&key=user_uploads/1899616/0dd981e5-f59d-40ec-8ee8-53782bb12622)

Overhiring in tech has led to over 200,000 layoffs, costing companies billions. Workforce costs account for 70-80% of a company’s expenses, yet companies still make workforce decisions in error-prone, manual spreadsheets with incomplete data. Re-orgs, department changes add to the pain. Reconciliation is messy and time-consuming. Accuracy suffers. The cycle perpetuates. As Taylor Swift might say, _“I’ve seen this film before, and I didn’t like the ending.”_

# 🪄 **Our Solution: AI-powered headcount management**

Modus integrates with your existing HRIS and ATS systems, using AI to help you detect anomalies, inspect, and correct your workforce plan.

With Modus:

❌ Overhiring\
❌ Layoffs\
❌ Incomplete data \
❌ Useless meetings \
✅ Hire and retain only the people you need\
**✅** Increase visibility\
**✅** Collaborate off a single source of truth\
**✅** Save costs as you scale

The more Modus learns, the more it streamlines and automates your headcount management processes at scale.

# 🙋🏻‍♀️**The Ask**

Know anyone in your network managing headcount, bogged down by spreadsheets? A VP in Finance, HR, or Operations? Please share this post (or the blurb below).
